title: Residue separability after tame DVR base change
statement: Let $B$ and $A$ be DVR domains [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], and give $A$ a finite faithful $B$-algebra structure. Let $n>0$ be a unit in $B$ and assume $\mathfrak m_B A=\mathfrak m_A^n$. Let $E/\operatorname{Frac}(B)$ be finite separable [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], with its composite $B$-algebra structure, and let $C=\operatorname{integralClosure}_B(E)$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. Assume for every prime $R$ of $C$ above $\mathfrak m_B$ that both its ramification index and residue degree divide $n$. For every maximal ideal $P$ of $D=E\otimes_B A$, give $F=D/P$ its $A$-algebra structure by the right tensor inclusion and put $S=\operatorname{integralClosure}_A(F)$. Assume $S$ is finite as an $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. For every prime ideal Q of S contracting to the maximal ideal of A, let S_Q be the localization at Q. For every proof that the canonical map A -> S_Q is local, the induced algebra of local residue fields k(S_Q)/k(A) is separable. The local-hom argument supplies the canonical residue-field algebra structure and is not a ramification bound.

source.place: Tags 032L (finite separable normalization), 0BRM (Abhyankar lemma), and 09E7 (adic smoothness of DVRs).

proof.text: Finite faithfulness of A over B induces a finite fraction-field extension K1/K. Since A is normal and integral over B, it is the integral closure of B in K1. The assumed ideal identity says its ramification index over B is n. The kernel of A -> F contracts to zero in B and hence is zero by integrality. Thus F is a field factor of the generic tensor E tensor_K K1.

The integral closure C of B in E is finite by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-normal-separable-integral-closure-finite], and is a Dedekind domain. Localize at each prime above m_B to get a DVR. The assumed e,f divisibilities and invertibility of n make e prime to the residue characteristic and f prime to it; the inseparable residue degree, a power of that characteristic dividing f, is therefore one. In residue characteristic zero, separability is automatic.

Apply Abhyankar lemma 0BRM to each resulting tame DVR and K1/K, whose base ramification index n is divisible by e. Integrality over A and over B in F are equivalent by integrality of A/B; localization of integral closure identifies S_Q with the normalized tensor factor of 0BRM. It is adically formally smooth over A. Use the appropriate consequence of 09E7: For every proof that the canonical map A -> S_Q is local, the induced algebra of local residue fields k(S_Q)/k(A) is separable. The local-hom argument supplies the canonical residue-field algebra structure and is not a ramification bound.

theorem dvr_tame_tensor_factor_residue_isSeparable
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (n : ℕ) (hnpos : 0 < n) (hn : IsUnit (n : B))
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [Algebra B A] [Module.Finite B A] [FaithfulSMul B A]
    (hindex : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B A) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ^ n)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (FractionRing B) E]
    (hE : FiniteDimensional (FractionRing B) E ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable (FractionRing B) E) :
    letI : Algebra B E :=
      ((algebraMap (FractionRing B) E).comp (algebraMap B (FractionRing B))).toAlgebra
    let C := integralClosure B E
    (∀ (R : Ideal C) (hR : R.IsPrime),
      letI := hR
      R.comap (algebraMap B C) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B →
        R.ramificationIdx B ∣ n ∧ R.inertiaDeg B ∣ n) →
    let D := E ⊗[B] A
    ∀ (P : Ideal D) (hP : P.IsMaximal),
    let := hP
    let F := D ⧸ P
    let alpha : A →+* F := (Ideal.Quotient.mk P).comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[B] D).toRingHom
    letI := alpha.toAlgebra
    let S := integralClosure A F
    Module.Finite A S →
    ∀ (Q : Ideal S) (hQ : Q.IsPrime),
    let := hQ
    Q.comap (algebraMap A S) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A →
      ∀ (hloc : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime Q))),
      letI := hloc
      Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime Q))
